item.title: ai: What’s new in Microsoft Foundry | September 2026
item.description:
The September 2026 Microsoft Foundry post highlights updates across models, Routines, Tool Search, Model Router, and Insights. It presents these changes through a two-agent workflow that turns public releases into a Foundry developer changelog.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: ai: What’s new in Microsoft Foundry: July and August 2026
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry’s July and August 2026 update adds stable Hosted Agent and Toolbox SDK paths, Claude tools support on Azure-hosted deployments, and Model Router updates. It also notes local inference improvements and SDK migration items to review before upgrading.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog
